test_title: PYST 38: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Dumbledore tells McGonagall that someone named Voldemort has killed a Mr. and Mrs. Potter and tried unsuccessfully to kill their baby son, Harry.

B. Dumbledore leaves Harry with an explanatory note in a basket in front of the Dursley home.

C. Mr. Dursley, a well-off Englishman, notices strange happenings on his way to work one day.

D. That night, Albus Dumbledore, the head of a wizardry academy called Hogwarts, meets Professor McGonagall, who also teaches at Hogwarts, and a giant named Hagrid outside the Dursley home.
